run_train_cli: run the fairseq training CLI to train a new model on one or multiple GPUs
run_main: run the main training loop that builds the model, criterion, and trainer then trains until convergence
run_validate: run validation on specified subsets to evaluate model performance and return validation losses
run_validate_mega_lm: run validation for mega LM tasks with chunked decoding and incremental states
run_should_stop_early: run early stopping logic to check if validation performance has plateaued beyond patience threshold
